numbering.reasoning: A black fret wrap sits at the headstock end of the fingerboard and hides the nut. From the W1–W2 spacing (~93 px), the nut would fall about 98 px left of W1, which is under the wrap. No wire is visible between the wrap and W1, so W1 is fret 1. This is consistent with the distinctive 12th-fret vine cluster lying between W11 and W12, and with W24 being the last wire before the fingerboard ends.

usability.reason: An electric guitar with a sunburst body and a vine-inlay fingerboard fills the frame, and the whole neck with about 20 fret wires is clearly visible, with only a few fingers covering part of it.
